## History

[Charlotta](../character/charlotta.md) the Fourth lived at [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge) as a fourteen-year-old handmaiden to Miss [Lavendar](../character/lavendar-lewis.md). She assisted [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and Miss [Lavendar](../character/lavendar-lewis.md) in preparing the cottage for the arrival of [Stephen Irving](../character/stephen-irving.md). After [Stephen](../character/stephen-irving.md) arrived, [Charlotta](../character/charlotta.md) watched from a window with [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) as Miss [Lavendar](../character/lavendar-lewis.md) and [Stephen](../character/stephen-irving.md) walked in the garden, confirming their reconciliation.

_Sources: [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P76](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0076), [v2 XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace P57](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0057), [v2 XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace P59](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0059), [v2 XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace P64](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0064), [v2 XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace P70](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0070)_

## Relationships

### [Lavendar Lewis](../character/lavendar-lewis.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/fourth--lavendar-lewis.md)

Fourth serves as a handmaiden and servant to Miss [Lavendar Lewis](../character/lavendar-lewis.md) starting in Volume 2. Along with [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md), Fourth assists Miss [Lavendar](../character/lavendar-lewis.md) at [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge) by helping her prepare for a visit from [Stephen Irving](../character/stephen-irving.md). During this visit, Fourth observes the garden from the window alongside [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md), witnessing the reconciliation between Miss [Lavendar](../character/lavendar-lewis.md) and [Stephen](../character/stephen-irving.md).

_Sources: [v2 XXVII An Afternoon at the Stone House P43](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0043), [v2 XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace P47](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0047), [v2 XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace P57](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0057), +3 more_

- Serves under — handmaiden and servant (since v2)  <sub>[v2 XXVII An Afternoon at the Stone House P43](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0043), [v2 XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace P47](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0047)</sub>

### [Shirley](../character/shirley.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/fourth--shirley.md)

Fourth and [Shirley](../character/shirley.md) are close chums who live and work together at the stone house. During [Stephen](../character/stephen-irving.md) Irving's visit to [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge), the two work together to help Miss [Lavendar Lewis](../character/lavendar-lewis.md) prepare for her guest. They later watch from the window as [Stephen](../character/stephen-irving.md) and Miss [Lavendar](../character/lavendar-lewis.md) walk through the garden together, confirming that the pair has reconciled.

_Sources: [v2 XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace P48](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0048), [v2 XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace P57](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0057), [v2 XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace P59](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0059), +2 more_

- Comrade of — chums living and working together at the stone house (since v2)  <sub>[v2 XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace P48](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0048)</sub>
